mil6.2.4:0.4: 4. What Is Not In the World
mil6.2.4:1.1: “It is said that in the world there exist Buddhas, Pratyekabuddhas, disciples of the Tathagata, wheel-turning monarchs, kings ruling a single province, devas and humans, rich people and poor, the well-gone and the badly-gone. A man’s female mark is manifest, a woman’s male mark is manifest; good and bad deeds exist; beings who experience the fruit of good and bad deeds exist as well. In the world there are beings born of an egg, born from moisture, born spontaneously, and born by meditation; there are beings with no feet, with two feet, with four feet, and with many feet. Yakkhas, rakkhasas, kumbhandas, asuras, danavas, gandhabbas, pretas, and pisacas exist in the world; so do kinnaras, mahoragas, nagas, supannas, magicians, and sorcerers. Elephants, horses, cattle, buffaloes, camels, donkeys, goats, sheep, deer, boars, lions, tigers, leopards, bears, wolves, hyenas, dogs, and jackals are said to exist; so are many kinds of bird. In the world there are gold, silver, pearls, gems, coral, quartz, rubies, cat’s eyes, lapis lazuli, crystal, black iron, copper, brass, and bronze; there are flax, silk, cotton, hemp, coarse hempen cloth, and wool; there are rice, paddy, barley, millet, kudrusa grain, beans, wheat, kidney beans, sesame, sesame, and vetches. Scents of roots, of heartwood, of accessory wood, of bark, of leaves, of flowers, of fruits, and of everything are found. Grasses, creepers, shrubs, trees, herbs, forests, both banks, rivers, mountains, oceans, fish, and tortoises: everything exists in the world
mil6.2.4:1.2: Whatever does not exist in the world, sir, tell me about it”.
mil6.2.4:2.1: “There are three things, Great King, that do not exist in the world.
mil6.2.4:2.3: A being with consciousness or a being without consciousness, free from aging and death, does not exist in the world; there is no permanence of formations; and truly, there is no such thing as the possession of a being. These, Great King, are the three things that do not exist in the world”.
mil6.2.4:2.4: “Good is it, sir Nagasena, I accept this exactly so”.
mil6.2.4:3.1: What Is Not In the World, fourth.
